name: Kamra PMS
what_it_holds: Open-source hotel/STR property-management system (Frappe framework): front desk, booking engine, billing/tax, housekeeping management, POS, WhatsApp integration, MCP tools for AI-agent-driven bookings/audits. No datasets committed. AGPL-3.0, 34 stars, 18 forks, 352 commits.
why_useful: Housekeeping/turnover workflow module exists but this is deployment software, not a data source; only relevant if a hotel/STR operator using Kamra agreed to share exports.
themes: Vacation rental damage/turnover/cleaning marketplaces (Turno, TurnoverBnB), STR supply services (Airbnb photographer, key exchange) datasets
why_all: Housekeeping/turnover workflow module exists but this is deployment software, not a data source; only relevant if a hotel/STR operator using Kamra agreed to share exports.

name: mews-systems
what_it_holds: Independent profile/documentation of the public API surface for Mews, a cloud PMS/RM platform used by 15,000+ hospitality properties (reservations, distribution, revenue management). Descriptive only; no committed booking-pace or OTB data, and Mews's actual reservation data is per-property/private, not exposed publicly.
why_useful: Marginal reference for what fields a PMS-level OTB/pickup feed would carry, but there is no accessible aggregate dataset behind it for a public researcher.
themes: Booking-curve / pace / pickup datasets for hotels and STRs (on-the-books, forward bookings), Key Data / Transparent / Lighthouse (OTA Insight) samples, revenue-management forward curves
why_all: Marginal reference for what fields a PMS-level OTB/pickup feed would carry, but there is no accessible aggregate dataset behind it for a public researcher.

name: hotel_booking_demand_EDA
what_it_holds: Exploratory data analysis notebook over the well-known Antonio/Almeida/Nunes Portugal hotel-booking-demand dataset (two hotels, ~119k bookings, 2015-2017, lead time and cancellation fields), focused on cancellation-rate trends driven by OTA sales tactics.
why_useful: This is the same Portugal hotel-booking-demand dataset CONTEXT.md already lists as held; flagging only because its lead-time/cancellation-rate framing lines up with gap 3 (booking lead time / cancellation-rate distributions), in case the specific cancellation cut is useful.
duplicate_of_holding: Portugal hotel-booking-demand dataset (Antonio/Almeida/Nunes) already held per CONTEXT.md

name: Predicting_Hotel_Cancellation_Rate
what_it_holds: Notebook/pipeline predicting hotel demand and cancellation likelihood from 'reservations on-the-books' for a hotel chain; explicitly frames the on-the-books / pickup forecasting problem management-consulting style. Likely built on the same public Antonio/Almeida/Nunes Portugal hotel-booking dataset (H1/H2, ~2015-2017) already held, rather than new raw data.
why_useful: Illustrative of the on-the-books forecasting method / cancellation-rate framing relevant to the RNPL (reserve-now-pay-later) cancellation thesis (gap #3), though it appears to reuse a dataset we already hold rather than add new data.
geography: Unspecified hotel chain (likely Portugal, same as held Antonio dataset)

name: Hotel-Hedonic-Pricing-Model-Project
what_it_holds: Repo with hotel_bookings.csv, a Hotel_Pricing_Model.ipynb notebook, and a 'Hotel Hedonic Pricing Analysis.pdf' report; hotel_bookings.csv is a very common filename matching the widely-used Portugal (Algarve/Lisbon) hotel-booking-demand dataset (Antonio/Almeida/Nunes) we already hold.
why_useful: Could be a hotel-side analogue to our Airbnb hedonic work (room-type/amenity/star-rating premia), useful as a cross-check methodology or if it carries a hotel-rate dataset we do not have.
themes: Airbnb and hotel price-elasticity, hedonic and mix-decomposition studies with data (bedroom counts, listing quality, superhost premium)
